summary: The statement and proof are correct. The smallest and degenerate cases, including singleton faces, one remaining coordinate, endpoint means, and zero variance, are covered. The entropy maximizer has precisely the claimed support and finite exponential parameters. The convolution and marginal log-concavity arguments, endpoint probability estimates, pairwise correlation identity, and translation overlap bound establish Delta <= 4 sigma. Prefix-coordinate rounding preserves the support and the exponential weight product. Theorem 1.2 of the cited arXiv:1911.04392v4 was checked directly and has exactly the four-function specialization used in both applications. The tail recursion, fourth-moment summation and numerical constant are valid, and the final Holder and Cauchy-Schwarz argument proves the stated closed-halfspace bound with all boundary mass retained. No mathematical errors or gaps were found.
